fields.name: Structured Query Language (SQL)
fields.description: SQL (Structured Query Language) is the standard programming language used to manage, query, and manipulate data stored in relational database management systems (RDBMS). It serves as the primary tool for communicating with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Oracle. Unlike procedural languages like Python or Java, SQL is declarative, meaning you describe what data you want rather than how to step-by-step retrieve it.
